command_interface.const: Future PE-5.3 entrypoint /home/jazofv1/hioc/pi4/bin/hioc-compose-service-associations.py: standalone no-network execution with fixed /home/jazofv1/hioc root and no environment/config overrides. Operator-managed source updates use future offline installer /home/jazofv1/hioc/pi4/bin/hioc-install-mqtt-mappings.py with explicitly supplied secret-free candidate file, no shell sourcing. Entry point bytes are PE-5.3 outputs; interfaces/paths selected here.

failure.const: Source failures produce unavailable configured branch with empty association set and counts; invalid inventory/clock/receipt causes whole unavailable output. Nonzero return code and fixed safe status/error log without endpoint/topic/device labels or credentials. Write failure leaves prior file, freshness gate rejects stale output.

input_path.const: /home/jazofv1/hioc/state/inventory/inventory.json; read finalized producer artifact only; no inventory engine execution or write

lock.const: /home/jazofv1/hioc/state/enrichment/service_associations/.lock; owner jazofv1 mode0600 in0700 directory; fcntl.flock LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB shared by composer and source installer

missed.const: No catch-up. Next normal cycle recomputes from current inputs. PE-6 expires old receipt at 1200 seconds or input expiry, whichever earlier; scheduler presence does not prove success.

model.const: Separate private standalone composer; accepted PE-5.1 pure resolver may be reused with unchanged schema/rules, but accepted caller executable and inventory engine remain byte-identical. No additional PE-5.1 execution occurs during PE-5.2.

operational_evidence.const: PE-5.8 requires at least three consecutive natural successful cycles plus synthetic/native bounded overlap, missed-cycle expiry, invalid/absent source and restart/corruption cases at PE-5.6/8; no destructive production faults without separate explicit authority.

overlap.const: No waiting/backlog; overlapping invocation returns fixed OVERLAP_SKIPPED code without replacing output. Lock FD held for full read/validate/write transaction; OS releases on exit/restart.

retry.const: No retry loop; next scheduled cycle. Manual bounded future diagnostic only with separate authority, no implicit second historical execution.

trigger.const: Future PE-5.7 operator-authorized jazofv1 cron entry: 2,17,32,47 * * * * using absolute future composer path and fixed root; disabled through PE-5.5. These are new design values, not observed schedule.

authority.const: Descriptive evidence only; PE-6 owns role_suggestion, metadata_quality and classification. No PE-6 implementation or public projection here.

content.const: Private envelope of untouched PE-5.1 schema1.0 result (or null if unavailable) and separately typed configured branch; inventory digest/updated time; source revision/digest; evaluation/deadline; provenance, accepted associations and safe rejection/error counts; bounded changes. No MQTT topics, payloads, credentials, names, health/status classifications, raw IP or MAC copied into configured output.

future_discovery.const: Different source_kind/schema/rule explicitly versioned under later authority. No configured provenance laundering of broker/HA/Discovery observations.

validity.const: PE-6 validates closed schema, metadata, timestamps/deadline and same-current input/source identities before use. Any current source change invalidates prior configured evidence immediately; stale/missing/invalid inventory or receipt -> unavailable, not empty healthy state.

reason.const: Input is explicit local configuration of opaque endpoint bindings. Evaluation requires only configuration plus reconciled local inventory, not broker presence, payloads, topics, HA entities or clients. Existing MQTT publishers/subscriptions/retention are unchanged; Ring -> cloud -> Ring-MQTT -> Mosquitto -> HA -> HIOC is preserved context, not verified live topology or authority to interrogate it.

atomic.const: Future implementation uses source snapshot immutability check, single shared flock, regular exclusive same-directory temp file, 0600, fsync(file), os.replace, fsync(parent). Reject symlink/nonregular/hardlink paths and unexpected metadata; never truncate current in place. No multi-file atomicity is claimed; source SHA/revision binds each output.

backup_recovery.const: Private source backed up only via separately authorized secret-free restricted operator workflow, no implicit new production backup job. Generated current is reproducible, not restored as authority. Source rollback requires higher revision; no PE-4 journals touched.

corruption.const: Source invalid => unavailable branch; inventory invalid => whole output unavailable; output invalid => PE-6 rejects. Partial/interrupted writes cannot produce a consumable mixed envelope.

history.const: One current envelope only, no relationship archive or hidden last-valid store. Prior receipt is comparison/revision evidence only when its configured branch is valid; an unavailable replacement cannot be used as a revision anchor. Source installer uses current valid source as its other anchor. No automatic use of stale associations.

lkg.const: No automatic fallback to stale associations. If source/input fails, write unavailable envelope if possible; if writing fails, old file remains physically but becomes unconsumable after validity deadline. Prior receipt is not relationship authority.

reason.const: Durable operator configuration is necessary across restarts; a private current relationship receipt provides atomic PE-6 consumption, provenance/revision checks and bounded changes without changing public inventory.

restart.const: Reread source/inventory; never recover associations from output alone. Corrupt existing receipt => PRIOR_STATE_INVALID, explicit authorized recovery before resumption. Missing receipt is first-run initialization, not corruption. Valid but unavailable prior receipt permits recomputation without diff baseline; source revision still checked against current approved source at installation. If neither valid source nor receipt anchors recovery, operator approves initial revision explicitly; no silent rollback protection claim.

retention.const: Current replaced atomically each evaluation; exclusive temp removed on handled failure. No unbounded journal/backup/history. Stale crash temp is never followed/used; future recovery validator identifies exact owned temp before separately authorized removal. Future retention project remains separate.

schema_storage.const: Design input/output schemas are embedded in governance/pe5/pe5-mapping-contract-design.json and printed in docs/PE5_MAPPING_CONTRACT_DESIGN.md. PE-5.3 must materialize or deterministically embed these exact schemas in its validator; installed schema hashes bind during PE-5.5. No runtime schema is installed now.

writer.const: One future PE-5.3 standalone private composer; never inventory-engine or PE-5.1 caller modifications

cardinality.const: One endpoint has at most one declared target device and optional service; many endpoints may attach to one device. No topic fanout inference.

conflict.const: Malformed source/duplicate/conflicting declarations -> no accepted configured associations for that cycle. Local and configured branches retain distinct provenance; no authoritative field overwrite or endpoint/name/IP fuzzy joins.

difference.const: Compare semantic relationship ID sets with prior valid configured output only when both snapshots are consumable. Sorted added/removed IDs limited to 64 each plus exact totals/truncated flag; initial/invalid prior state yields baseline=false and no fabricated removal claims.

duplicates.const: Exact duplicate rows and repeated mapping_id invalidate the entire source. Multiple rows with same endpoint, even same owner, invalidate the source; conflicting endpoint owners are configuration conflict, not inferred merge.

identifier_allocation.const: Operator allocates endpoint_id and mapping_id once as UUID4 lowercase32-hex with me_/map_ prefixes and maintains their binding in private configuration. They do not derive from topic/IP/name/device labels. Preserve endpoint_id when configuration revision changes; retire and allocate a new ID for a different endpoint. Mapping row IDs do not confer identity authority.

identity.const: Target must exist exactly once in finalized inventory with valid normalized MAC, ID==existing stable_device_id(MAC), no MAC collision; mapping cannot create/merge identities or override IP. Missing/weak/ambiguous device -> rejection, never synthetic device.

meaning.const: DECLARED_ENDPOINT_DEVICE_ASSOCIATION: operator assertion that an opaque MQTT/integration endpoint belongs to an already reconciled device; not ownership discovery, connectivity, health, role or a dependency graph

missing.const: Unknown endpoint is not probed. Opaque declared endpoint requires no independent live existence proof. Missing target device/service -> per-row rejection. Service owner mismatch or ambiguous service ID -> per-row rejection.

provenance.const: source_kind=configured_mqtt; source_id; source revision and digest; mapping_id; rule_id=declared_endpoint_device_v1. Future discovery evidence needs separately authorized source_kind and rules; never silently shares configured authority.

relationship_id.const: mqra_ + SHA256(ASCII canonical JSON array ['configured_mqtt_v1',source_id,endpoint_id,device_id,service_id,'endpoint_to_device']). mapping_id/revision/evaluation time are excluded so unchanged semantic bindings retain IDs.

service.const: Null or an existing finalized inventory service ID whose strongly bound owner is the same device; no new service inferred. Supported ID grammar remains the closed PE-5.1 service ID grammar.

atomic_input.const: Source and inventory fingerprints/stat stable before/after read and immediately before output replace. Change aborts with SOURCE_CHANGED or INVENTORY_INVALID. Later changes invalidate consumer use through same-current digest comparisons.

comparison.const: All configured rows share validated source revision/digest. baseline=false => zero changes/counts; baseline=true => exact complete difference counts, sorted arrays capped64, accurate truncation flag. Unavailable branches never report fabricated removals.

deadlines.const: VALID deadline strictly after evaluation and no later than evaluation+1200 or inventory.updated+2100. Whole UNAVAILABLE deadline==evaluation. Invalid clock produces no fabricated timestamp or replacement; fixed failure, old receipt expires.

deployment.const: Exact installed bytes are PE-5.3 implementation outputs; entrypoint/installer paths and interfaces are already defined here. PE-5.5 installs disabled runtime plus schemas, preserving existing source and refusing unexpected target contents. No source auto-created. PE-5.6 requires approved real positive mapping plus bounded nonactive negative fixtures.

local.const: Embedded PE-5.1 result must pass unchanged validator, policy2100, same inventory digest/time/evaluation. No local schema/rule/caller changes.

root_state.const: VALID means current inventory/time prerequisites usable, not that all branches are valid. UNAVAILABLE means no branch consumable. local=null means unavailable, never zero confirmed local associations.

schema_evolution.const: New kinds/fields/identifier grammar require separately governed schema/rule version. Output2.0 wraps unchanged local1.0; never silently substitutes it.

serialization.const: Sorted associations by relationship_id; rejections by mapping_id/code. Canonical ASCII compact sorted-key JSON plus LF; strict UTF-8; duplicate JSON keys and NaN/infinities rejected; byte/array bounds applied before ingestion.

source_install.const: Future installer and composer share lock. Installer compares current valid source and prior valid configured receipt where available; no hidden retained last-valid store. If neither anchor is available, explicit operator-approved initialization/recovery is required. Composer never writes source.

source_state.const: Configured VALID requires revision/digest, null error_code, candidate_count==accepted+rejected, unique IDs/endpoint declarations. UNAVAILABLE requires empty accepted associations and fixed nonnull error; revision/digest null and candidate_count/rejections zero when source cannot be safely validated.

authority.const: Operator-approved explicit configuration, accepted only after closed-schema/identity/revision validation; filesystem ownership alone is insufficient

availability.const: Required for a complete configured branch. Absence is SOURCE_ABSENT, never proof no relationships or no devices. Explicit approved empty mappings array is valid known-empty configuration; operator source provisioning occurs only in later authorized deployment.

configuration_authority.const: Future offline installer accepts only an explicit operator-approved artifact; composer reads only fixed path. No empty configuration automatically created by deployment: absent source remains unavailable until separately authorized operator provisioning. Source schema lives in this governed contract, then PE-5.3 validator/exact installed schema; permission ownership is a necessary safety check, not the producer-authority proof.

failure.const: Absent/unreadable/wrong owner/mode/link/schema/bounds/corruption -> configured branch unavailable, safe fixed error code; no partial source ingestion. Existing local branch may remain separately valid.

privacy.const: Private 0700 source directory, 0600 regular single-link non-symlink file; owner resolved from jazofv1 during future deployment. Source excluded from Git/release/public MQTT/HA. No labels, topic strings, URLs, client IDs, credentials or private authentication material.

revision.const: Integer 1..9007199254740991; every authorized content change increments revision. Canonical SHA256 identifies complete content. Future installer compares current schema-valid source and prior valid configured receipt when available: equal revision with changed digest/lower revision rejected. Intentional rollback requires a higher revision. If no valid anchor exists, fail closed until explicit operator recovery supplies an approved initial revision; no historical anti-rollback proof is claimed.

selection.const: One fixed production-root-relative path; no config/environment fallback, known-infrastructure/integration auto-promotion, globbing or live discovery

time.const: Configuration state, not observation. No observed_at/last_seen timestamp or file mtime authority. Active declarations remain until replaced/removed; no wall-clock TTL. Inventory validity is checked independently at each evaluation with accepted 2100-second policy.

update.const: Offline validation -> same-directory exclusive temporary file -> mode 0600 -> flush/fsync -> atomic replace -> parent directory fsync under shared PE-5 lock. Source and output files remain distinct; no secret required.

writer.const: Authorized operator using a future PE-5.3 offline configuration validator and atomic installer; no broker/HA/existing inventory writer
